_readme: English -> Turkish glosses for exercise i18n maps. Keys are the exact English string stored under data.*.i18n.en; values are the Turkish shown to a learner whose native language is Turkish. Applied by TurkishGlossSeeder, which is idempotent. Capitalised variants are separate entries on purpose: they appear sentence-initially. Turkish has no definite article, so 'the' is glossed as a grammar note rather than a word.
